claim_scope: This is one continuous executable traversal over archived experiment artifacts. It verifies gate logic and evidence linkage, but it is not a fresh online run of all four loops.

options.summary: Human-Gated Agentic Tree Search for Automated Research
evidence: Run matched research tasks with no human gates, idea-only gates, branch-selection gates, and claim-audit gates.
Expert paper-quality score, unsupported-claim count, experiment budget wasted on discarded branches.
risks: Human feedback may be too subjective unless captured in a strict schema.

evidence: Compare AI Scientist-v2 topic-file ideation against multi-agent hypothesis debate on the same benchmark tasks.
Novelty, feasibility, evidence grounding, and downstream experiment success.
risks: The benefit may disappear once constrained by runnable benchmarks.

options.summary: AlphaEvolve-Style Subproblem Optimization Inside Automated Research
evidence: Use OpenEvolve on selected algorithmic or ML-pipeline components within a research task and compare against direct LLM edit search.
Metric gain, number of valid candidate programs, wall-clock/API cost, paper-level usefulness.
risks: Local metric improvements may not change the final research conclusion.

options.summary: Co-Pilot AI Scientist v3 End-to-End System
evidence: Build an orchestration layer with logged human gates and run two small research tasks end to end.
End-to-end reproducibility, expert review, benchmark results, and artifact completeness.
risks: Scope is large; requires careful staging to avoid a broad but weak paper.

gates.rationale: Select the narrow human-gated tree-search contribution because it is the most experimentally defensible core and can absorb Co-Scientist and OpenEvolve modules as supporting layers.
follow_up_checks: Keep full-system superiority as an unproven target claim.

options.summary: Accept candidates using only their target metric.
evidence: Fairness degenerate predictor can game demographic parity.
risks: Metric gaming and non-executable branches can pass too late.

options.summary: Require execution/correctness checks and task-utility floors before continuation.
evidence: MLAgentBench vectorization direct rewrite failed correctness gate.
Fairness repair probe shows single-metric gaming risk.
risks: May reject some creative but initially incomplete branches.

gates.rationale: The current artifact set contains both invalid fast code and fairness metric-gaming examples, so the evaluator gate must approve guardrails before additional search budget is spent.
follow_up_checks: Report invalid or metric-gamed candidates as failures, not wins.

options.summary: Use direct LLM edits for all machine-gradeable subproblems.
evidence: Knapsack direct score=0.995270
Sklearn direct RMSE=55.895460
risks: Can fail correctness gates on vectorization and may under-explore combinatorial tasks.

options.summary: Escalate richer automatic-evaluator subproblems to OpenEvolve.
evidence: Knapsack OpenEvolve score=0.999439
MLAgentBench vectorization median speedup=132.67x
Sklearn median OpenEvolve RMSE=55.895460
risks: Tiny-budget search is seed-sensitive and does not always beat direct editing.

gates.rationale: Escalate selectively: OpenEvolve is useful for richer or correctness-gated subproblems, while the sklearn tabular result shows direct editing can match it on standard small modeling changes.
follow_up_checks: Require direct-edit baselines before claiming program-search gains.

options.summary: Claim that Co-Pilot v3 outperforms autonomous AI Scientist-v2.
evidence: Pair-1 gated test MAE=0.402170; autonomous=0.421474
risks: Current broader matched evidence is mixed and too small.

options.summary: Claim feasibility, evaluability, and boundary conditions while reserving superiority claims.
evidence: Branch gate and continuation are executable.
Program-search escalation has positive and boundary-condition probes.
Paper-quality reviews ask for more matched tasks and seeds.
risks: A narrower claim is less ambitious but better supported.

gates.rationale: The selected continuation beats the first matched autonomous baseline by 0.019303 MAE in this pair, but the full evidence set is still mixed. The paper should claim an executable co-pilot architecture and logged boundary conditions, not general superiority.

downstream_budget.next_required_run: single online four-loop trajectory with equal-budget autonomous baseline

follow_up_checks: Run more matched tasks and seeds.
Add independent paper-quality ratings after a true online full trajectory.

remaining_gap: A true online full-gate experiment must generate ideas, approve evaluators, select branches, run program search, and audit claims in one continuous run, then compare against a matched autonomous baseline.
